roleTitle: Registered Nurse (RN) - Staff Development & Infection Control
description: Join a dedicated team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as a Registered Nurse specializing in Staff Development and Infection Control. This pivotal role offers the unique opportunity to shape the clinical competency of our staff while safeguarding the health and well-being of our residents through robust infection prevention strategies. As an SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive educational programs for nursing staff, ensuring compliance with current healthcare standards and best practices. Simultaneously, you will lead our infection control initiatives, conducting surveillance, providing training, and implementing protocols to maintain a safe and healthy environment for everyone. We are seeking a proactive and knowledgeable RN passionate about both education and patient safety. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control within a healthcare setting
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care and infection control
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility located in Sarasota County, FL. This is a highly confidential opportunity for a results-oriented professional ready to make a significant impact on census growth and community engagement.The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to enhance the facility's reputation and drive admissions. This role requires a proactive individual with a strong ability to build relationships, manage outreach initiatives, and effectively communicate the facility's value proposition to potential residents, families, and referral sources. Occasional weekend work will be required to support community events and facility tours.This position offers a compelling compensation package for the right individual who can demonstrate a proven track record of success in healthcare marketing. If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for connecting people with quality care, we encourage you to explore this unique opportunity.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or long-term care environment.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement effective marketing and outreach strategies.
Professional demeanor and excellent presentation skills.
Ability to work occasional weekends to support facility events and tours.
Proactive, results-driven approach to market development and census growth.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance for the right candidate.

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a PRN Speech Language Pathologist. This critical role offers a competitive hourly rate of $38 - $49, along with a generous $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus. We are seeking a dedicated professional to provide essential speech and language therapy services to our residents on an as-needed basis.

In this vital PRN position, you will have the flexibility to manage your schedule while making a significant impact on patient recovery and quality of life. You will work within a supportive environment, collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to develop and implement individualized treatment plans.

This is an urgent opening, and we are looking for a compassionate and skilled SLP ready to contribute immediately. If you are passionate about helping patients regain communication and swallowing abilities, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current Florida state licensure as a Speech Language Pathologist
Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP) from ASHA
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
salaryOrBonusInfo: $38 - $49/hr with a $5,000 sign-on or relocation bonus.
